data.one_liner: Emulates C# Guid in Flutter to generate UUIDs and add Guid variables to classes.
data.what_it_does: Emulates the C# Guid type within Flutter applications. It allows you to generate new UUIDs, add Guid variables to classes, and safely compare two Guid variables case-insensitively.
use_when: You need to emulate C# Guid behavior in your Flutter classes.
You need to guarantee data validity for UUID values.
avoid_when: You prefer using pure Dart UUID generation without C# wrappers.
strengths: Ensures validity of data when working with UUID values.
weaknesses: Limited to emulating C# Guid features.
Documentation does not cover all edge cases.

alternatives.name: uuid
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is the underlying package used for generating UUIDs.
